narrative.details:
Ok, here we are... a pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say!  I've seen the Cenarion Circle forces arrive at Silithus.  They plan to drive the Twilight's Hammer out, don't they?  This will help.

Take this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith.  Soon the Twilight's Hammer will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good!
narrative.objectives: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
narrative.offerRewardText: This is very interesting information indeed, adventurer.  This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them.  Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, Champion.
narrative.requestItemsText: What is this you bring to me, adventurer?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 58 to 60, 25,900 XP in all.

quests.name: The Twilight Mystery
quests.objectiveText: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

quests.name: The Deserter
quests.objectiveText: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: The Twilight Lexicon
quests.objectiveText: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: A Terrible Purpose
quests.objectiveText: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
